value.signature: fn evaluate (bound : & BoundProcedure < '_ > , d : & ScheduleDeclaration , search : & InverseSearch , ridge : Option < & CheckedRidge > ,) -> Result < Evidence , Error >

review.body: { let fence = crate :: fence :: search (bound , None) ? ; let (p , input) = inputs (bound , d , search , & fence) ? ; let controller = pn_graph :: numeric :: controller :: evaluate (& p , & input , ridge) ? ; let burn_image = image (& p , d , & controller) ? ; Ok (Evidence { declaration : d . input () . clone () , search : search . clone () , fence , controller , burn_image , }) }
review.item_premise: Only declared public inputs and frozen compiled widths enter the controller. Independent reconstruction checks every inverse attachment, branch and delivered error; immutable evidence does not confer schedule validity or final admission.
